notes.title: ENTRY 2.0 — The Complete Redesign of Game
notes.content:
[b]ENTRY 2.0 - The Ultimate Word Strategy Game[/b]
I am excited to announce the launch of ENTRY 2.0 on Steam - a completely rebuilt and refined word strategy game that combines the best elements of classic word games with modern design and technology.
[h1]What is ENTRY?[/h1]
ENTRY is a strategic word game played on a 5×5 grid. Starting with a center word, players take turns placing a single letter adjacent to existing letters, forming new words by tracing paths through neighboring letters. Each word must include your newly placed letter, creating an ever-evolving puzzle of interconnected words.
[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[b]Refined Gameplay[/b]
[list]
- [b]Perfect Balance[/b]: Easy to learn, yet offers deep strategic possibilities
- [b]Quick Matches[/b]: Games typically last 5-10 minutes, perfect for quick sessions
- [b]Scoring System[/b]: Words score points equal to their length, rewarding vocabulary depth
[/list]
[b]Multiple Game Modes[/b]
[list]
- [b]Solo Play[/b]: Challenge a sophisticated PC opponent
- [b]Online Multiplayer[/b]: Connect with random opponents or create private lobbies with friends
[/list]
[b]Customizable Experience[/b]
[list]
- [b]Visual Themes[/b]: Choose from 7 distinct visual styles including Cyberpunk, Matrix, Steampunk, Tron, Vaporwave, and more
- [b]UI Customization[/b]: Adjust the interface to suit your preferences
[/list]
[b]Technical Improvements[/b]
[list]
- [b]Cross-Platform Play[/b]: Seamless play between desktop app, web browser and mobile versions
- [b]Offline Support[/b]: Full functionality without an internet connection
- [b]Optimized Performance[/b]: Smooth gameplay on all supported devices
[/list]
[b]Community Features[/b]
[list]
- [b]In-game Chat[/b]: Communicate with opponents during online matches
- [b]Move History[/b]: Review past moves to learn and improve your strategy
- [b]Word Validation[/b]: Comprehensive dictionary with thousands of valid English words
[/list]
[h1]Why ENTRY?[/h1]
Unlike many word games that rely heavily on luck or memorization, ENTRY rewards strategic thinking, spatial awareness, and vocabulary skills in equal measure. The game's elegantly simple rules create nearly endless possibilities, with each match unfolding in unique and surprising ways.
Whether you're a casual word game enthusiast or a strategic mastermind, ENTRY offers a fresh challenge that will keep you engaged match after match.
[i]Download ENTRY today and discover why this word game deserves a place in your collection![/i]
